_about: Coach wording. Each message is composed from interchangeable parts: a title, an evidence sentence and an action sentence. The renderer picks one of each, avoiding the parts used in your last 5 messages of the same kind, and keeps the same phrasing for the same insight once shown. Placeholders: {fact}, {fact|one|many} for plurals, {fact:clock} for seconds as m:ss. {unit} is lb or kg. Every message carries at least one of your numbers, except safety lines.
